mapper.insert: insert into CC_NOTICE (NOTICE_TITLE, NOTICE_CONTENT, COMMENT_YN, CREATE_DT, UPDATE_DT, NOTIFICATION_YN, DELETE_YN, VIEW_COUNT, EMP_ID) values (#{noticeTitle}, #{noticeContent}, #{commentYn}, #{createDt}, #{updateDt}, #{notificationYn}, 'N', 0, #{empId})

insert into CC_FILES (ORIGIN_NAME, STORED_NAME, CREATE_DT, UPDATE_DT, FILE_SIZE, FILE_PATH, FILE_CONTENT) values (#{originName}, #{storedName}, #{createDt}, #{updateDt}, #{fileSize}, #{filePath}, #{fileContent})
insert into FILES_TYPE (FILE_NO, TYPE_INFO, DOC_ID) values (#{fileNo}, 'B', #{docId})
